content.short: Cyan enables Buy Now, Pay Later for NFT purchases in the Metaverse.
content.description: Cyan makes high-quality NFTs more accessible by enabling Buy Now, Pay Later for NFT purchases across Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, BNB Chain, and Arbitrum. By offering flexible payment terms, Cyan lowers the upfront cost of coveted digital assets, helping collectors and traders enter the metaverse without sacrificing ownership. The service focuses on straightforward financing that respects ownership rights, aiming to broaden participation in NFT markets while supporting responsible purchasing in a fast-moving ecosystem.
